seed_choice_rule: chosen as fresh integers disjoint from the seed inventory; the inventory and its evidence paths are recorded below
question: Does a delivery-specific TRAINED reconstruction component, at matched wall budget and matched actual decoder calls, beat the non-learning reconstructor on full contract cost?

closed_roles: pretrained zero-shot guide as insertion-position score (D-GUIDE-v1)
pretrained zero-shot guide as regret ranking key (D-GUIDE-v1)
pretrained zero-shot guide as destroy operator, decode-cost matched (D-DESTROY-EQ8-v1, -4.84 percent vs discard control)
hand-designed and simplified-classical mask choices vs uniform random (D-MASKHEUR-v1, D-DESTROY2-v1)
why_this_is_not_a_repeat.what_is_new: every closed role reused the SAME frozen zero-shot CVRP checkpoint and only re-wired where its logits were consumed; no experiment has ever TRAINED a delivery-specific component. 'No transfer' is not the same claim as 'no training', and the audit records this as the one untested path.
measured_bounds_that_make_it_unpromising: the mask-choice channel shows no signal even for the strongest hand-designed and simplified-classical operators
the pretrained direction is worse than a random same-architecture direction in every role tested

registered_arms.trained: delivery-specific reconstruction component, trained only on TRAIN split, frozen before any DEV/CONFIRM evaluation
registered_arms.regret2_nolearn: the existing non-learning reconstructor, unchanged - the arm to beat
registered_arms.zeroshot_guide: the frozen zero-shot checkpoint consumed exactly as in the closed role, for continuity
registered_arms.discard_control: pays one identical decoder call per step and discards the output, so consumed compute is matched and information value is separated from throughput

matched_resources.note: matching the consumed resource is the discipline that D-DESTROY-v1 lacked and D-DESTROY-EQ8-v1 restored; a control must match the treatment on every resource the treatment consumes

data_plan.train_split: fresh seed, never used by any delivery panel in either cycle
data_plan.confirm_split: three fresh complete-day cohorts, only after dev selection
forbidden: reusing any instance id or seed already observed in either cycle
reading confirm splits before the dev gate passes
seed shopping, resampling, or dropping incomplete states

registered_seeds.mask_rng_note: the mask RNG is registered separately from the dataset seed because every delivery panel in both cycles drew its mask schedule from a mask seed distinct from its dataset seed; one mask seed is registered per confirmation cohort so that the three cohorts are independent
registered_seeds.disjointness_basis: scripts/research_20261010/DELIVERY_SEED_INVENTORY.md; disjointness is established only against seeds recorded in the archives that were searched

seed_provenance.engineering_run_status: ENGINEERING-ONLY. The run at dataset seed 202610101701 with mask seed 202610101702 is a one-instance (17000) feasibility export of 41 samples produced by scripts/research_20261010/delivery_traintask_data_export.py. Its own result.json states isa_protocol_train_split=false and that it 'is NOT the protocol TRAIN split and must not be reused as one'.
seed_provenance.rule: 202610101701 and 202610101702 are ENGINEERING-ONLY and must NEVER be used as a protocol split, at any stage, for any arm of D-TRAINTASK-v1.
seed_provenance.note: the forbidden seeds of the protected block are not used by any registered split here; they remain protected exactly as the draft recorded them

gates.dev: trained beats regret2_nolearn with mean relative cost improvement >= 1 percent and paired 95 percent CI lower bound > 0
gates.confirm: same gate on all three fresh cohorts, plus full identity/trajectory/hard-feasibility/timeout replay
gates.multiplicity: dev selects one configuration only; a pre-declared confirmation alpha controls the selection; no re-selection after seeing confirm numbers
gates.no_equivalence_claim: a CI spanning zero means the difference is not established, never equivalence; no equivalence boundary is registered here

required_artifacts: every public packet and every candidate evaluation
best and baseline full typed traces with independent terminal replay
contract hash, dataset hash, source start/end SHA, checkpoint SHA
actual decoder-call counts, per-phase wall seconds, and every timeout or failure retained
training data provenance, the frozen trained weights, and the training run's own identity

explicit_non_claims.note: the panel shares the versioned C0 evaluator; its physics is not independently calibrated

frozen_protocol_sha256.rule: SHA-256 over the exact bytes of this file with the value of frozen_protocol_sha256.value replaced by the literal ASCII string PENDING_SELF_SHA. A self-referential digest cannot contain itself, so the placeholder rule is stated explicitly and the digest is independently recomputable. The on-disk SHA-256 of the file as finally written is recorded in scripts/research_20261010/DELIVERY_SEED_INVENTORY.md.
